data.name: Creator's Will
data.description: You can cast minor creation as a spell-like ability. You can have no more than one minor creation active at a time. If you cast the spell again, the previous casting immediately ends. At 12th level, this ability improves to major creation. You can use this ability %1 times per day.|ArcanistSavantSchoolLVL/2
